service_profile.service_description: Remote Workforce Housing Basecamp Trailer Rentals for project teams that need temporary crew accommodation at or near a jobsite. Plan sleeping accommodation and requested basecamp support around crew size, shift schedules, site conditions, and rental duration. Trailer models, amenities, capacity, and deployment scope are confirmed with the company quote.
target_customer_types: mining, forestry, and other remote project operators
prioritized_use_cases: remote construction and infrastructure crew accommodation
utility installation and maintenance project basecamps
energy and industrial project workforce housing
temporary lodging for phased projects and rotating crews
field-team accommodation where on-site housing is required

sleeping_accommodation: Review workforce housing or sleeper trailer configurations against the requested crew size, room-sharing preferences, shift schedules, and project duration. Confirm the actual beds or bunks, room layout, approved occupant capacity, furnishings, privacy provisions, and any bedding arrangements before booking. No bed count, room type, or trailer model is assumed to be standard.
climate_control: Confirm heating, cooling, ventilation, insulation, and seasonal suitability for the proposed accommodation units and site conditions. Required power, fuel, operating limits, and any cold-weather or hot-weather provisions are reviewed for the approved configuration before dispatch.
basecamp_preparation: Plan the accommodation layout, placement areas, access routes, crew circulation, and requested support facilities before delivery. Review stairs, ramps, lighting, and other access or site-support items for suitability and availability. Additional equipment is included only when listed in the approved quote.
sanitation: Review restroom, shower, handwashing, and wastewater needs for the crew and rental term. Confirm whether facilities are integral to the chosen accommodation units, require separate trailers, or will be provided at the site. Laundry facilities may be requested for review; availability and service scope must be confirmed. Cleaning, consumables, water supply, tank servicing, and waste removal responsibilities are agreed before occupancy.
storage: Review personal belongings, workwear, and other permitted storage needs with the selected housing layout. Confirm the supplied storage provisions and any separate storage or common-area requests. Do not assume lockers, secure storage, or additional common-use space are included with every trailer.
utilities: Review the approved power supply and connections, potable water where required, wastewater arrangements, fuel where applicable, climate-control loads, site access, trailer placement, and required approvals. Where fixed utilities are unavailable, request a separate review of temporary power, water, and wastewater options; self-contained operation is not assumed.

preparation_plan.purpose: Prepare the approved workforce housing trailers and requested basecamp support equipment for crew accommodation, then maintain their condition and readiness between rental assignments.
before_delivery: Clean sleeping areas, supplied furnishings, high-touch surfaces, and any included shared facilities.
Check the approved accommodation equipment, doors, windows, climate-control systems, lighting, and connected services for functionality.
Match the approved accommodation plan to the crew headcount, shift pattern, project dates, and site conditions; confirm capacity and included amenities.
Review placement areas, delivery access, utilities, stairs, ramps, and requested support equipment before dispatch.
during_off_rent_maintenance: Inspect accommodation areas, supplied furnishings, climate-control systems, and associated equipment between rentals.
Repeat cleaning, sanitation, and condition checks for sleeping areas and any included restroom, shower, or laundry facilities.
Document service needs, complete approved maintenance, and confirm readiness for the next workforce housing assignment.
preparation_plan.additional_equipment_note: Additional basecamp equipment is subject to request, site requirements, availability, and company approval. Access equipment, sanitation facilities, laundry arrangements, and temporary utility support must be expressly included in the quote before being treated as part of the rental.

utilities_plan.power: Verify the approved power source, electrical capacity, connection type, and connection locations for all selected housing and support trailers, including climate-control and other equipment loads.
utilities_plan.water_supply: Confirm potable water availability, required pressure and flow, connections, and any water replenishment arrangements for the approved accommodation and sanitation facilities.
utilities_plan.wastewater: Confirm the approved wastewater connection or holding and removal arrangements for any included restrooms, showers, handwashing, and laundry facilities; assign servicing responsibilities before occupancy.
utilities_plan.fuel: Confirm fuel requirements, storage, access, and replenishment responsibilities for any approved heating or temporary power equipment; fuel-dependent equipment is not assumed to be included.
utilities_plan.ventilation: Review ventilation, heating, cooling, clearances, and seasonal suitability for the selected accommodation units and their placement.
utilities_plan.site_access: Verify delivery and recovery routes, suitable and level placement areas, clearances, pedestrian access, stairs, ramps, and access to supporting facilities.
utilities_plan.approvals: Confirm applicable site permissions, occupancy approvals, inspections, local requirements, and utility coordination with the responsible parties before the facilities are occupied.
utilities_plan.pre_delivery_check: Confirm that the approved layout, access, utilities, supporting services, and site preparations are ready before dispatch; agree the checks required before crew move-in.
utilities_plan.confirmation_note: Exact utility specifications and occupancy-readiness requirements depend on the approved accommodation units, support facilities, and site. The company and responsible site parties must confirm them before deployment.

sanitation_plan.purpose: Maintain clean and serviceable crew accommodation and included basecamp facilities throughout the rental lifecycle.
before_delivery: Clean sleeping areas, supplied furnishings, high-touch surfaces, storage spaces, and any included restroom, shower, or laundry facilities.
Check water, drainage, waste, and connection points associated with the approved configuration.
Document the condition of the accommodation units and confirm the agreed cleaning, bedding, and servicing arrangements before handover.
after_rental: Remove customer belongings, waste, and customer-supplied materials according to the agreed return responsibilities.
Clean sleeping areas, furnishings, storage, and included shared facilities; handle any supplied bedding or linens according to the agreed rental scope.
Inspect the units, document cleaning and condition findings, and record repair or service needs before release.
off_rent_maintenance: Keep housing trailers and supporting facilities clean and serviceable between workforce accommodation assignments.
Inspect and maintain climate-control, electrical, water, drainage, furnishings, and other components included in the approved units.
Resolve documented service items and confirm cleaning and condition readiness before the next assignment.
sanitation_plan.confirmation_note: Confirm cleaning, sanitation, inspection, and maintenance responsibilities with company operations. Ongoing housekeeping, laundry service, consumables, and wastewater servicing are not assumed to be included unless specified in the rental agreement.

rental_options.extension_policy: Rental extensions may be requested before the scheduled return date and are subject to trailer availability, continued site suitability, and company approval. Any revised rental period, pricing, delivery or relocation costs, and return arrangements must be approved before the extension becomes effective.
rental_options.relocation_policy: Relocation requests must be submitted before the trailer is moved and are subject to company approval, route and access review, site suitability, utility disconnection and reconnection requirements, availability, and any applicable transport, setup, or relocation charges. The trailer must not be moved without prior company approval.

service_profile.commercial_focus: project-based crew accommodation and coordinated basecamp planning, with configuration, rental duration, deployment phases, and support responsibilities defined before mobilization

pricing.pricing_basis: Project-specific workforce housing and basecamp quote; no published starting rate. Price depends on approved accommodation capacity, unit configuration, unit count, rental term, transport, setup, and included support facilities.
pricing.delivery_fee: Delivery is quoted for the approved number and type of housing and support trailers, dispatch origin, destination, route, site access, setup scope, and return arrangements. Special transport and additional mobilization requirements are confirmed separately.
pricing.minimum_rental: Request a project-specific quote for remote workforce housing and basecamp trailer rentals. The minimum rental term and charge depend on the approved accommodation configuration, number of units, crew requirements, project duration, location, transport, setup, and any requested support facilities. No starting rate or minimum term is published until confirmed by the company.

city_discount_policy.rule: No automatic ETA-based discount is applied. Any location or term adjustment must be confirmed in the workforce housing quote.

supporting_basecamp_facilities.pricing_basis: Any requested restroom, shower, laundry, or other basecamp support facilities are priced only after availability, configuration, and inclusion in the project scope have been confirmed. No support-facility rate is published.

service_hours.hours: See the service-area page for location-specific operating hours

delivery.typical_eta: Confirm the project-specific dispatch, transport, setup, and crew move-in schedule with the quote; road-travel references are not deployment lead times.
delivery.delivery_notes: Coordinate the housing site, approved trailer layout, crew arrival dates, delivery windows, utilities, setup responsibilities, readiness checks, and return arrangements. For multi-unit basecamps, confirm the delivery sequence and any phased occupancy. Existing location travel figures are unverified planning references for this service; actual timing depends on the approved dispatch origin, fleet availability, route, site access, and setup requirements.
delivery.availability_fallback: If the requested housing configuration is unavailable from the proposed dispatch location, another approved source may be reviewed. Confirm any resulting changes to unit configuration, transport cost, and deployment schedule.

faqs.question: What are Remote Workforce Housing Basecamp Trailer Rentals used for?
faqs.answer: The service is focused on temporary crew accommodation for remote worksites and project assignments. Requests may involve construction, infrastructure, utility, energy, industrial maintenance, or other field operations. The accommodation plan depends on the crew, project dates, site conditions, and available approved units.

faqs.question: How many workers can a housing trailer accommodate?
faqs.answer: There is no single capacity stated for all units. Confirm the actual sleeping layout, beds or bunks, approved occupancy, room-sharing arrangements, and trailer configuration before booking. Larger crews may require multiple approved units rather than an assumed increase in occupancy.

faqs.question: Are showers, restrooms, and laundry facilities included?
faqs.answer: Do not assume these are included in every housing trailer. Review whether the selected configuration has integral facilities, whether separate units can be supplied, or whether the site will provide them. Laundry and other support requests require confirmation of availability, utilities, service responsibilities, and pricing.

faqs.question: What does the site need before the trailers arrive?
faqs.answer: Confirm suitable placement areas, delivery and recovery access, the approved layout, required power and water, wastewater arrangements, and stairs or ramps where needed. The company and responsible site parties must agree any permissions, inspections, and occupancy-readiness checks before crew move-in.

faqs.question: How much does remote workforce housing rental cost?
faqs.answer: Request a project-specific quote. Pricing depends on the approved unit types, accommodation capacity, unit count, rental duration, destination, transport, setup, and support facilities. No fixed starting rate, per-person rate, minimum term, or automatic location discount is published for this service.

faqs.question: Can the housing be rented for a long-term project or extended?
faqs.answer: Short-term and long-term requests can be reviewed. Extensions must be requested before the scheduled return date and depend on availability, continued site suitability, company approval, and an agreed revised rental term and price. Renewal is not automatic.

faqs.question: Do the location travel estimates tell me when crews can move in?
faqs.answer: No. The location figures are inherited road-travel planning references, not confirmed housing deployment lead times. Equipment sourcing, dispatch, transport, site preparation, utility connections, setup, and agreed readiness checks must be scheduled before crew move-in. Remote or non-road destinations require a separate logistics review.

faqs.question: Can a basecamp be relocated as the project moves?
faqs.answer: Request approval before moving any trailer. Relocation depends on the route, replacement site, unit availability, safe disconnection and reconnection, and any transport or setup charges. Updated placement, utilities, and occupancy readiness must be confirmed at the new site.
